items.t: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Starts Phase 3 Cancer Study, Weighs Next Steps for Obesity Drug
items.sum: Corbus Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:CRBP) has begun a Phase 3 study of its lead cancer drug in second-line oropharyngeal cancer and is considering further development of an obesity treatment that recently completed a Phase 1b study, CEO Yuval Cohen said during a Jefferies fireside chat. items.t: Biotech ETFs Brace for FDA Showdown: Two Drug Decisions Could Test Investor Sentiment
items.sum: XBI and IBB lagged SPY and QQQ as two FDA decisions and fresh Alzheimer's and obesity-drug data put biotech ETFs in focus.
